warnings.claim: The sustainability-related financial disclosures are prepared to provide decision-useful information that can be read together with the entity’s general purpose financial statements.
The sustainability-related financial disclosures relate to and are prepared for the same reporting entity as the related general purpose financial statements.
The sustainability-related financial disclosures cover the same reporting period as the related financial statements and are reported at the same time as those financial statements.
The related financial statements are the entity’s consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2024.
Monetary amounts in these sustainability-related financial disclosures are presented in euro (EUR), which is also the presentation currency of the related financial statements.
In the current reporting package, the sustainability-related risks and opportunities described in this General Requirements section are climate-related.
Information is not incorporated into these sustainability-related financial disclosures by cross-reference.
These sustainability-related financial disclosures are authorised for issue at the same time as the related financial statements.
There was no change to the reporting period in the period, and these sustainability-related financial disclosures are not presented as interim sustainability-related financial disclosures.
